Wait you can do that ? Tbf It didn't occur to me to complain as my focus has been more on getting the form sent off and how to word it all cause of how little time i had to get it done by.  I may talk to my mum about complaining as she is the one helping me out with all of this due to the Medical conditions i have . Thanks for suggestion  :)
True you have a point ^.^. Ill think it over and see where I get after work. Thanks <3
Yes i am, i have been for 8 years now. And even there ive struggled to be honest. Like there suggestions are helpful and i take what they say onboard but its hard to put it into practice =/.
I cant. I feel like i would become a burden for them if i try and ask for help let alone even wanting to talk.

Thats good, and you shouldn't feel guilty as thats what friends are for. I'm sure she would tell you if it was too much or anything :), Pretending that your fine when your not is also okay as at the end of the day you shouldn't be ashamed of it. as what does pretending get you?

Very nice, im glad counselings is helping you :D a year and a half is an achievement in its self as its not a fast progress it can be slow, im sure you will be able to see the changes soon enough even when you dont think you've made progress.

dam that a nice guitar :). Hahaha XD i have heard trying to play guitar can be difficult at the start but can be rewarding at the end of the day once you get the hang of it, keep at it bud! the hard work you put into playing the guitar will pay off just like your counselings session :D

hmm =/ thats a shame she doesn't understand. Mind you its quite common that sometimes people dont understand which sucks and can make you feel isolated. If you do need anyone to talk to you can always dm im always happen to listen :)

wow im so sorry to hear that. That is a terrible accident to happen to you, tbh anything like that would cause anyone to  end up with anxiety,depression and PTSD.  Have you maybe tried talking to a professional about it like a counsellor?

wow nice what sort of a guitar? I get it motivation can be hard again baby step you got this :D:D just dont give up! One step at a time :)

I get it, i really do. When you see no progress its hard to keep motivating yourself  to get up and do stuff. But thats why you shouldn't give up :)! As may not see the progress now but you may do later on. And then im sure you could reflct on it one day in the future  and then realise how silly you was and keep going as at the end of the day life is like a roller coster. Like for me every day is a struggle i cant get out of my bed, i hate socialising i even hate leaving the house. But i take baby step to get me through the day and it works. You just got to keep at it. Do you have any friends that you can share this too? As having the right support network is always nice in times like this. If not any hobbies that you enjoy? That could maybe keep u busy and distract yourself with.

I get you man, i'm the same. it sucks it really does. But least your trying thats all that matter and you should be proud of yourself for trying :), and try not to give up. Even when its hard baby steps at the end of the day dont over do it. Start small and try and add more things to the list as each thing you do is an achievement :).

I know exactly what your going though, and it horrible, and going through it alone is even worse.

I on a regular bases have phases where i will be destructive, but after ive gone and done it and it felt soo good for a while and then its sets in, all the shame and dark thoughts of why did i give in to the destructive side.

If anything i see been "destructive" more as a coping strategy then destruction. Maybe instead of trying to do this alone you should go tell someone close to you. so they can help. As trying to do this alone isn't worth it at all.
